comment: REUSE-style path-to-licence mapping for files that carry no SPDX-License-Identifier header. It restates LICENSES/README.md in a form scripts/sbom.py can check; it does not change the licence of any file. A file's own SPDX header always takes precedence over a rule here, and the longest matching path wins. Checked by: python3 scripts/sbom.py spdx-coverage

rules.basis: LICENSES/README.md: kernel/audio/** is GPL-2.0-only, except files carrying their own SPDX license expression
LICENSES/README.md: project-owned userspace code is AGPL-3.0-only (root LICENSE)
LICENSES/README.md: project-owned firmware integration is AGPL-3.0-only (root LICENSE)

LICENSES/README.md: project-owned documentation is AGPL-3.0-only (root LICENSE)
